**Direct answer:** No. Public evidence cannot establish NVIDIA's exact realized AI-chip market share in 2030. Today is 2026-10-27, so 2030 hasn't happened. Any 2030 figure is a projection, and the 2030 outcome can't be observed yet. Even for past years, "exact" share is out of reach, because no one publishes a standard denominator for the AI-chip market.

I used four of my eight retrievals: three searches and one page read. Most share figures come from third-party analyst sites, not primary data.

**Observed (company-reported, hard data)**

- NVIDIA reported Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended July 26, 2026) revenue of $96.2B and Data Center revenue of $89.0B, up 117% year over year.
  - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000073/q2fy27pr.htm
  - https://themodelpress.com/news/2026/10/nvidia-q2-fiscal-2027-results
- Q3 FY2027 revenue guidance is $108B ±2%, and it assumes no China data center compute revenue. This is guidance, not an outcome.
  - https://gpuinsights.net/nvidia-data-center-revenue-q2-fy2027/
- These figures are NVIDIA's own revenue. They don't give a market share, because they have no agreed denominator.

**Estimates of past or current share (analyst-derived, not exact)**

- One analyst site estimates NVIDIA's revenue share at 75% in 2022, 86% in 2023, 87% in 2024 and 81% in 2025.
  - https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/nvidia-ai-accelerator-market-share-2024-2026
- The same site says the market-size denominator, AMD revenue and custom-silicon revenue are its own estimates, based on TrendForce and TSMC capacity data.
  - https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/nvidia-ai-accelerator-market-share-2024-2026
- That page is internally inconsistent. For example, its 2025 share is 81% in the table but 80–90% in the summary.
  - https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/nvidia-ai-accelerator-market-share-2024-2026
- Other sources give a range of roughly 80–90% for the data center accelerator market. AMD is put at about 5–7% in 2025, and custom ASICs at roughly $15B.
  - https://commandlinux.com/statistics/ai-gpu-market-share-nvidia-vs-amd-vs-intel/
  - https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/amd-vs-nvidia-ai-gpu-market-share-2026
- Market-size definitions differ by roughly 5×. One firm puts the 2025 AI accelerator market at $33B, while another uses about $160B. That alone makes "exact" share impossible.
  - https://www.kaisoresearch.com/blog/ai-accelerators-market-431b-by
  - https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/nvidia-ai-accelerator-market-share-2024-2026
- By units, JPMorgan forecasts NVIDIA plus AMD GPUs at about 58% of 2026 accelerator shipments, down from 68% in 2025. Unit share and revenue share differ.
  - https://commandlinux.com/statistics/ai-gpu-market-share-nvidia-vs-amd-vs-intel/

**Projections (not outcomes)**

- The same analyst site projects NVIDIA at 75% in 2026, with a "floor" of 65–70%. Its forecasts stop at 2026 and include nothing for 2027–2030.
  - https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/nvidia-ai-accelerator-market-share-2024-2026
- I found no authoritative, sourced 2030 NVIDIA share forecast. Searches returned mostly stock price targets.
  - https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/07/14/where-will-nvidia-stock-be-in-2030/
  - https://fxopen.com/blog/en/analytical-nvidia-stock-price-targets/
- Market-size projections for 2030 are broad:
  - AI capex of $3–4T by 2030.
  - TSMC's view implies an addressable AI data center chip market of about $825B.
  - A market CAGR of 29% through 2030.
  - https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/25/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-reaffirms-his-4-trillion-p/
- Commentators say NVIDIA's share may have peaked, with pressure from AMD and custom chips from Broadcom and the hyperscalers. Others argue a more chip-heavy build-out would offset any share loss. These are opinions, not data.
  - https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/07/14/where-will-nvidia-stock-be-in-2030/

**What would settle it:** NVIDIA's FY2031 and calendar-2030 filings, together with competitors' 2030 filings (AMD, Broadcom, and the cloud providers' custom-silicon disclosures). Even then, share would depend on whichever market definition an analyst chose, so it would remain an estimate.

**Limits:** I did not find or read sell-side or tracker reports from Morgan Stanley, Bernstein, IDC, Gartner or TrendForce, which may hold paywalled 2030 forecasts. Most share figures above come from low-authority aggregator sites, so treat them as rough.
